title: athel/fact-access@1
description: One use of a fact in .athel/knowledge/access.jsonl (doc 03 verification rule 6; FR-DISC-004). Written by the CLI for every use, in a change or an ad-hoc question.

result.description: in_window: verified within its freshness window; verified: re-verified for this use; unverified: a recipe tool was unreachable; refused_stale: a decision use of a fact outside its window, refused.

age_s.description: Seconds since the fact was last verified, at the time of use.
